metadata.name: Survey Department Nepali Romanization System (1997)
metadata.description: Survey Department, Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives and Poverty Alleviation, Government of Nepal.
notes:
ं (anusvara) is rendered by
      ṅ before क, ख, ग, and घ
      ñ before च, छ, ज, and झ
      ṇ before ट, ठ, ड, and ढ
      n before त, थ, द, and ध
      ṁ before य, र, ल, व, श, ष, स
